sentences.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission investigated whether serious misconduct occurred in the award of a security services tender by the Mid West Ports Authority.
sentences.support: which led to the commencement of an investigation to determine whether serious misconduct had or may have occurred

sentences.text: The Commission identified risks arising from departures from ordinary procurement and tender procedures.
sentences.support: the Commission's investigation identified several serious misconduct risks regarding the deviation from standard procurement and tender procedures during the process.

sentences.text: The Commission made no serious misconduct finding against any employee of the authority and reported the risks to assist public authorities with prevention.
sentences.support: did not make a finding of serious misconduct against any MWPA employee.

notes: INTRODUCTION provides an overview of the investigation, its purpose and outcome; used as the equivalent summary. The existing OPAX finding is not duplicated.
